app-templates.message:
fix(quiz): the end-to-end tests of every quiz scroll instantly

## Intent

The quiz scrolls smoothly unless the learner asks for less motion, and every click of the generic tests waited for that scroll to settle: about a second per question. The run through a whole quiz timed out from about 15 questions on, so a larger quiz failed its own check.

## Key changes

- quizTests() runs with reduced motion, so every scroll ends with the click. The default timeout stays, and every question is still answered.
- A fixture bank with 64 questions of every type, and a CI job that checks the quiz template as an app with it. It failed before the fix; the full run now takes about 8.5 s.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The tooling moves its template pin to this fix (e5a30fa), so new apps get it.
